description:
兔兔生活（爱佳肴）里的需求缺口：帮店主选址、帮运营补数据的 Agent 调用；搜索没结果，或想知道哪里缺店时用。
    Called by agents helping owners pick sites or fill data gaps; use after an empty search or to see what is missing.
    data.items 每项：city、district（可空）、want（菜系或场景）、asks（被问次数）、misses（无结果次数）、last_seen。
    Each data.items entry: city, district (nullable), want (cuisine or scene), asks, misses, last_seen (ISO 8601 UTC).
    按 misses 从高到低；只含汇总计数，不含用户原话；misses 不足 2 次的不列出，最多 100 条。
    Sorted by misses, highest first. Aggregated counts only, no raw queries; fewer than 2 misses omitted; max 100.

city.description: 只看某城市，如“成都”，不填为全国 / filter by one city, e.g. “成都”; omit for all of China
city.title: City

days.description: 统计最近几天，1–90，默认 30 / lookback window in days, 1-90, default 30
days.title: Days

name: get_unmet_demand
